definitions.gloss: unwanted items, disused articles, unnecessary goods
definitions.explanation: Items that are no longer needed or used; things to be disposed of or donated.

examples.japanese: {不用品|ふようひん}を{処分|しょぶん}した。
{不用品|ふようひん}を{売|う}ってお{金|かね}にした。
examples.english: I sold unwanted items and made some money.

examples.japanese: {不用品|ふようひん}{回収|かいしゅう}サービスを{利用|りよう}した。
examples.english: I used a junk removal service.

notes:
COMPOUND: {不用|ふよう} (unnecessary) + {品|ひん} (goods)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {不用品|ふようひん}を{処分|しょぶん}する (dispose of unwanted items)
- {不用品|ふようひん}{回収|かいしゅう} (junk removal, collection of unwanted items)
- {不用品|ふようひん}{買取|かいとり} (buying unwanted items)
- {不用品|ふようひん}を{売|う}る (sell unwanted items)

RELATED:
- {不要|ふよう} (unnecessary)
- {粗大|そだい}ゴミ (large garbage, bulky waste)
- リサイクル (recycling)

In Japan, flea markets (フリーマーケット) and online platforms like メルカリ are popular for selling {不用品|ふようひん}.
